reason: Resolution-1 union puts 99.39%-99.71% of connected lncRNA anchors in one group, so the module prior gives nearly all connected lncRNA the same shrinkage multiplier.
selection_basis: Graph-only probe at resolutions 1,2,4,8; choose the smallest tested resolution keeping the largest connected-lncRNA group at or below 25% in all three cancers. This criterion was set after inspecting the topology probe, without patient outcomes.
targets: All original 8750 candidate outcomes per cancer; same failure rules
validation: Same two repetitions of five outer folds and two repetitions of three inner folds, plus final fit; same 17-lambda and four-power grids
interpretation: Exploratory structurally motivated follow-up, not originally prespecified; original experiment retained in full.
required_comparisons: Resolution4 union vs adaptive-omics and equal ridge
Resolution4 union vs five resolution4 degree-preserving nulls
All three RNA arms on matched patients and targets
scope_note: No change to patient assays, native scores, clinical covariates, source exclusions or splits.
